summary: Avrupa Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a news release announcing the closing of a C$570,000 private placement on December 29, 2025. The company issued 11,400,000 units at C$0.05 per unit, each consisting of one common share and one non-transferable warrant exercisable at C$0.075 until December 2028. A director participated for 1,000,000 units, constituting a related-party transaction exempt from formal valuation and minority approval under MI 61-101. Proceeds will fund exploration in Finland and Portugal and working capital. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation.
